issue: C7/house31 wall hint inserts an extra blank line and scrolls out its first sentence on V321
cause: The native renderer performs its wrapping test even for a zero-width run of spaces/control characters. Padding spaces before FF trigger a soft wrap and FF adds a second line. Original Z80 05B2..05D0 dispatches controls before glyph-width tests; 066B increments X without the wrap check.

private_candidate.source_basis: Original 05B2..05D0 dispatches empty/control characters before width checks; 066B only adds6 to X. Native empty word wrap adds an extra line before FF.
